violation_type.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs -Free Standing Arch Climbers (26 TAC §746.4605(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs -Free Standing Arch Climbers
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has a prohibited play equipment on the playground.

finding_variants.text: The operation has a prohibited play equipment on the playground.
Evidence obtained during the investigation proved that children under the age of 5 have been playing on the arch climber on the playground.

Active play equipment was added onto the playground for infants and toddlers. The climbing equipment are pallets used to form a triangle for climbing up one side and down the other. This free standing arch climber is considered prohibited equipment for children less than 5 years of age.  The climbing equipment are pallets used to form a triangle for climbing up one side and down the other. The pallets are not sanded and have pieces of the wood that is splintered where the children grasp the pieces of wood to climb. Additionally, the climbing equipment lacks loose fill within the 6 foot use zone.

Three and four year olds were observed climbing a play structure that is prohibited for children under five. This was corrected when the children were no longer playing on the climbing play structure.
A free standing arch climber was present on the playground used for children ages 3-5.
